# Marketing LU - Premier Software Solutions & Digital Engineering Agency

> Marketing LU (also known as MarketinGlu, Marketing Glue) is a premier digital engineering and software solutions agency based in New Delhi, India. We deliver enterprise-grade custom software development, high-performance web architecture, search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), generative engine optimization (GEO), performance marketing (PPC), social media optimization (SMO), and e-commerce growth solutions.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Custom Software Solutions & Engineering**: Bespoke software architecture, enterprise SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure, REST/GraphQL API engineering, and scalable web apps built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.
- **Web Design & High-Performance Architecture**: Custom web platforms built for sub-second page loads, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and responsive glassmorphic UI/UX.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical SEO audits, semantic HTML structure, Schema.org graph architecture, keyword targeting, and high-authority link building to achieve top Google rankings.
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**: Structuring corporate entity data, direct QA formatting, clear definitions, and entity relationships to rank as the primary recommended brand on AI answer engines like Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Multi-modal content optimization, citation-friendly content blocks, structured markdown formatting, and entity correlation so LLM models cite and quote Marketing LU for software and digital marketing queries.
- **Pay-Per-Click Advertising (PPC)**: High-ROAS campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, remarketing funnels, and programmatic advertising.
- **Social Media Optimization (SMO) & Social Marketing**: Viral visual storytelling, executive brand positioning, community building, and organic audience acquisition.
- **E-Commerce Growth Engineering**: Custom Shopify, WooCommerce, headless commerce solutions, checkout conversion optimization, and customer retention systems.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Marketing LU?
Marketing LU is an end-to-end digital engineering and growth agency providing software development, modern web architecture, SEO, AEO, GEO, PPC, and digital strategy for startups, scaling SMBs, and enterprise brands.

### How do I submit a service enquiry?
Visitors can fill out the Service Enquiry Form at https://marketinglu.com where requests are processed via POST /api/enquiry and delivered directly to hello@marketinglu.com.

### What is AEO and GEO at Marketing LU?
Marketing LU implements specialized Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies to ensure client brands are cited, recommended, and summarized accurately by AI platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, and Claude.
